_note: BTS 2026 booth wording switch. With BTS.liveDemos = false (src/config/bts.ts: no booth with demos confirmed), the home page and the BTS landing page use these neutral lines instead of the booth/stand/demo lines in src/data/home.json and src/content/pages/bts-2026/page.json. Each line is the original with the booth/stand/demo part removed or changed to the owner's wording ('meet us at BTS', 'a 30-minute session'). The 'replaces' fields quote the original.
